failure_policy: Stop on source mismatch/fidelity failure/failed frozen bracket/unresolved declared certificate. Preserve logs; no retuning.
freeze: Written before any numeric evaluation of the new map/collisions. Roots solve declared equations, not a parameter/accuracy search.
interpretation: Exact equal F pairs are defined by real roots certified by IVT; finite printed approximations need not be bitwise equal. Rank statements exclude reset surfaces. Collision existence does not yield a numerical population accuracy ceiling.
no_search: Do not alter a values, b brackets, neighborhood, or tests if a proof/test fails. Record failure. Bisection is equation solving inside frozen brackets.
not_done: No nonlinear decoder fitting or Bayes accuracy estimate
No cue oracle fed into original decoder
randomness: None. Deterministic rational fixtures; no seed required.
scope: Analytic reachable clean response map, one bounded diagnostic; no decoder training, no original Probe1/P1B/v11 rerun, no Codex.
